# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: The relevant seal inscription form is 之 (forward motion) written in reverse. 帀 therefore suggests feet pressing on the ground in stamping or in marching back and forth (compare 踏) → *circulate* (← return to one's starting point).
周也。从反之而帀也。凡帀之屬皆从帀。周盛說。

The relevant seal inscription form combines 止# (stand straight) and 平 (spread level/flat) → straight line of stalls/shops comprising a *market* → *buying/selling*; *transaction*; *have dealings* → *city* (← place where many gather). There is no etymological connection with 姉.
買賣所之也。市有垣，从冂从绁，绁，古文及，象物相及也。之省聲。
The relevant bronzeware inscription form is as per 父# (spread) + 巾 cloth → *cloth* *spread* over an object.
枲織也。从巾父聲。
As per 凡# (a sail) + 巾 cloth → a *sail*. 帆 was devised to replace 凡 after 凡 acquired its associated meanings.
帛三幅曰帊。从巾巴聲。

The relevant seal inscription form shows two sets of intersecting lines + 巾# cloth → long piece of cloth (compare 衣) with fine cross-stitches → *rare* (← rare, high-quality cloth) → *desire*/*hope* (← desire/hope to obtain something rare).
金幣所藏也。从巾奴聲。
囊也。从巾代聲。或从衣。
弘農謂帬帔也。从巾皮聲。
白 white, here an abbreviated form# of 袙 (warrior's) headband + 巾 cloth → *kerchief*; *hood*.

As per 占# (fixed in place) + 巾 cloth → image transferred to and fixed on cloth as a rubbing → *document*; *paper*; *bill*; *notice* (compare 牒). Also, *counter* for Japanese paper, tatami, folding screens and other objects. For rubbings, compare 摺 and 搨.
帛書署也。从巾占聲。
一幅巾也。从巾犮聲。讀若撥。
失# slip + 巾 cloth → cloth *book cover* slipped over a *book*. Compare 袟.
書衣也。从巾失聲。
又 hand/action indicator + an element# indicating a broom → *sweep*, the hands wrapped about the handle of a broom.
糞也。从又持巾埽冂内。古者少康初作箕、帚、秫酒。少康，杜康也，葬長垣。
白# white + 巾 cloth → white silk cloth → *white cloth*; *silk*; *silk goods*.
繒也。从巾白聲。凡帛之屬皆从帛。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character depicts objects straightened into a unity, suggesting a supreme god unifying heaven and earth. Compare 君 and 王. Later, the term was applied to an *emperor*, whose functions and powers extend in like manner over the earth.
諦也。王天下之號也。从丄朿聲。
在上曰帟。从巾亦聲。
囊也。今鹽官三斛爲一帣。从巾𢍏聲。
巾帤也。从巾如聲。一曰幣巾。
A variant of 師 (lead soldiers), specifying a *general* or *supreme commander*.
佩巾也。从巾、𠂤。
As per 帀# (march) + an abbreviated form of 追 pursue an enemy army → lead (marching) soldiers → *army*. *Teacher* is a borrowed meaning (compare 帥) → *study under*; *boss*.
二千五百人爲師。从帀从𠂤。𠂤，四帀，眾意也。
下裳也。从巾君聲。

An abbreviated form# of 庶 (pile) + 巾 cloth → pile seating mats on the ground/floor (for a feast) → *mat* → *rank*; *post*; *position*; *seat* (← determining the placement of one's seating mat). Also, *spread* (a mat) and *cushion*.
籍也。《禮》：天子、諸侯席，有黼繡純飾。从巾，庶省。
長# long + 巾 cloth → long cloth → *screen*; *curtain*; *canopy* → *counter* (for rolls of cloth etc.); *record book*; *register* (← information recorded on long scrolls).
張也。从巾長聲。
帬也。一曰帗也。一曰婦人脅衣。从巾戔聲。讀若末殺之殺。
The relevant seal inscription form combines 巾 cloth with an object run through with string or cord → tie a *belt* about the waist, constricting it → *wear*; *carry*; *zone*; *accompany*.
紳也。男子鞶帶，婦人帶絲。象繫佩之形。佩必有巾，从巾。
A variant form of 幃 *curtain* with the additional meaning *screen* (n.).
在㫄曰帷。从巾隹聲。
As per 尚# (rise → raise) + 巾 cloth → raise a long skirt. *Normal*, *ordinary*, *continual* and *unending* are borrowed meanings.
下帬也。从巾尚聲。
As per 冒# (wrap about the head) + 巾 cloth → wrap-about *headgear*.
As per 貞# (upright) + 巾 cloth → (red) cloth hung upright → *cloth spread straight* → *flatten/paste* (a cloth, scroll or picture onto a surface).
As per 韋# (go around) + 巾 cloth → *curtain* (that surrounds).
囊也。从巾韋聲。
屋# cover + 巾 cloth → heavy, covering *curtain*.

As per 畐# as described in 副 (abundance) + 巾 cloth → piece of *cloth* of abundant *breadth*/*width* → *range*; *fabric*; *apron*; *counter* (for scrolls); *edge* → *influence* (← wide-ranging influence).
布帛廣也。从巾畐聲。
As per 封# (conical object) + 巾 cloth → long cords of (white) cloth supporting the side of conical sandals → *help*; *assistance*.
覆衣大巾。从巾般聲。或以爲首鞶。
As per 晃# (extend) + 巾 cloth → rounded piece of cloth extending over a frame → *canopy*; *cloth screen*; *curtain*. Also, (soft) *vehicle roof*.
冥# darkness + 巾 cloth → *covering* (placed over the face of a corpse); *cloth covering*.
幔也。从巾冥聲。《周禮》有“幎人”。
南郡蠻夷賨布。从巾家聲。
囊也。从巾朕聲。
幟也，以絳幑帛，箸於背。从巾，微省聲。《春秋傳》曰：“揚幑者公徒。”
As per 曼# (long and winding object that covers/is covered) + 巾 cloth → *banner*; *drop curtain*.
幕也。从巾曼聲。
As per 莫# (concealed) + 巾 cloth → concealing *curtain* → *act* (of a play) (← curtain marking the start/end of one act ).
帷在上曰幕，覆食案亦曰幕。从巾莫聲。
幟也。从巾𤐫聲。
As per 國# (enclosure) + 巾 cloth → *woman's hood or other form of head covering*.
婦人首飾。从巾國聲。
As per 責# (pile) + 巾 cloth → *turban* (← cloth piled upon the head).
髮有巾曰幘。从巾責聲。
車弊皃。从巾單聲。《詩》曰：“檀車幝幝。”
As per 菐# as described in 僕 (rough) + 巾 cloth → rough cloth of a *turban* → *kerchief*.
帊也。从巾菐聲。
As per 戠# as described in 織 (marker) + 巾 cloth → *flag* serving as a marker or *sign* → *streamer*.
旌旗之屬。从巾戠聲。
覆也。从巾無聲。
As per 番# (spread) + 巾 cloth → *pennant/streamer* spreading in the breeze → *flag*; *flutter*. Compare 旛.
書兒拭觚布也。从巾番聲。
As per 童# (run through) + 巾 cloth → *flag* or *military banner* run through by a flagpole.
旌旗之屬。从巾童聲。

As per 敝# (split) + 巾 cloth → cloth split in half (and, in ancient times, used as *currency*). *Shinto offering* (strips of fabric or paper containing prayers, and which are hung on trees) is an associated meaning.
帛也。从巾敝聲。
䰍布也。从巾辟聲。《周禮》曰：“駹車大幦。”
歛髮也。从巾喿聲。
馬纏鑣扇汗也。从巾賁聲。《詩》曰：“朱幩鑣鑣。”
壽# (long and curved) + 巾 cloth → long *drop curtain*/*canopy* → *cover*.
禪帳也。从巾𠷎聲。
蓋幭也。从巾蔑聲。一曰襌被。
車幔也。从巾憲聲。

A depiction of a forked stick or *thick bar*, one functioning as a *shield* and employed by being *thrust* or pressed against a combatant in *defense*. *Dry*, *ebb*, *draw/drain off* and *empty* (a glass) are borrowed meanings.
犯也。从反入，从一。凡干之屬皆从干。

entries.text: A depiction of a water weed spread flat upon the surface of water → *level*; *flat* → *fair*; *calm*; *usual* → *common*; *ordinary*.
語平舒也。从亏从八。八，分也。爰禮說。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 禾 grain/rice + 千# (advance through luxuriant vegetation) → advance through crops in harvesting → *year*; *age* (← harvest as the end of a long agricultural cycle; compare 歳).
干# thick bar (doubled), suggesting pieces of wood being ground down into alignment → *flat*; *level*; *smooth*; *even* (adj.).
平也。象二干對構，上平也。凡幵之屬皆从幵。徐鉉曰：“幵但象物平，無音義也。”
The relevant seal inscription form shows 并 to be a variant of 竝 line up/arrange → *align*; *combine*; *put together* → *in addition*; *also*.

並.explanation: alongside, and; common traditional writing in 并且 (bìngqiě). The 2013 standard treats this glyph as a variant of 并.
並.example: 并且 → 並且; 合并 → 合併

併.explanation: join/merge, e.g. 合并 → 合併 (hébìng). The 2013 standard treats this glyph as a variant of 并.

entries.text: 相從也。从从幵聲。一曰从持二爲并。
A depiction of handcuffs for confining the movement of prisoners. *Good fortune* and *happiness* are extended meanings (← a prisoner's good fortune to escape his handcuffs).
An abbreviated form# of 乾 (rise high) + 干 thick bar → high-rising tree with a thick *trunk* → *main part*; *vitality*.

entries.text: One-half of a depiction of slender, curved threads (compare 絲 as described in 糸) → *slender, curved thread*; *small* (and slender). Also, *young* and *childish/childlike* (← small being ← slender/small).
小也。象子初生之形。凡幺之屬皆从幺。

The relevant seal inscription form is a reverse image of the seal inscription form of 予 (stretch), suggesting the faintly visible tip of a thread stretching/protruding beyond a surface. The present style combines 幺 slender thread with an element signifying a slight wavering. The common reference is to a faintly wavering, slender thread → *illusion*; *vision*; *specter*; *phantom* → *confusion*.
相詐惑也。从反予。《周書》曰：“無或譸張爲幻。”
幺# slender thread + 力 power/energy → *infant* (← young person of slender/slight power).
少也。从幺从力。

An element# doubling 幺 slender thread (→ slight, obscure objects) + 山 mountain → obscure, remote mountain, *far removed from human habitation* → *unknown*; *deep*; *dark*; *profound*; *faint* → *afterlife*.
隱也。从山中𢆶，𢆶亦聲。

A variant form of 我# (bladed weapon) + an obsolete character doubling 幺 slender thread → slice threads repeatedly, *little by little*, causing them to become *minute* and *almost equal* in size → *slight*; *(a) few*; *some* (← minute in size or quantity). Also, *almost*. *How much/many* and *which* are borrowed meanings.
微也。殆也。从𢆶从戍。戍，兵守也。𢆶而兵守者，危也。

entries.text: An abbreviated form of 廣 (long building): *building*.
因广爲屋，象對剌高屋之形。凡广之屬皆从广。讀若儼然之儼。
A simplified, variant form of 莊 storage barn → *farmhouse* → *manor* → *village*.
比# line up + 广 building → *eaves* lining a roof → *cover*; *protect*. Compare 軒.
蔭也。从广比聲。
樓牆也。从广屯聲。

广 here a variant of 爿# long, wooden sleeping pallet + 木 tree/wood → *bed* ( compare 牀) → *floor*; *stool* (← things on which it is possible to sleep) → *ground*; *stratum* (← "bed" in figurative senses); *alcove* (← shelf board shaped like a bed/sleeping pallet) → *barber* (← stool on which a customer sits while having his hair cut). *Tasteful* and *elegant* are borrowed meanings.
支# branch + 广 building → shelves branched about a pantry → *cupboard* → *put away*; *to store*.
廡也。从广牙聲。《周禮》曰：“夏庌馬。”
As per 予# (stretch) + 广 building → rooms stretching in a line within a building → *beginning*; *order* (← beginning of a sequence) → *describe* (← describe in sequence/order; compare 敍) → *preface*.
東西牆也。从广予聲。
氐# foundation + 广 building → foundation of a building → *bottom* → *reach* (a point/destination) (← reach bottom); *stay*.
山居也。一曰下也。从广氐聲。
包# envelop + 广 building → *kitchen* (located deep within a building compound).
廚也。从广包聲。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 广 building → *store*; *shop* 　(← trade conducted in a fixed place, as opposed to itinerant peddling) → *inn* → *rented house*.
A depiction of a *firm* husk. *Seventh in a series* and *seventh calendar sign* are borrowed meanings.
位西方，象秋時萬物庚庚有實也。庚承己，象人𪗇。凡庚之屬皆从庚。
As per 付# (set in place) + 广 building → *storehouse* with goods placed throughout → *governmental office*; *capital*; *administrative division*.
文書藏也。从广付聲。
羊 here an abbreviated form# of 養 nurture; bring up + 广 building → (ancient) *school* where children were nurtured.
禮官養老。夏曰校，殷曰庠，周曰序。从广羊聲。
礙止也。从广至聲。
儲置屋下也。从广寺聲。
An abbreviated form# of 庶 (pile) + 又 hand/action indicator → pile objects in small increments in measuring carefully → *measure*; *degree*; *times* → *whenever*.
法制也。从又，庶省聲。
坐# sit + 广 building → place indoors where people *sit* → *seat* → *constellation* (← gathering of stars); *theater* (← grouping of seats).
祭山曰庪縣。从广技聲。
車# vehicle + 广 building → *storehouse* for covering vehicles.
兵車藏也。从車在广下。
As per 廷# (extend; court) + 广 building (for emphasis/clarity) → *garden*; *law court*; *governmental office*; *home*. Also, an *open space* extending straight through the middle of a manor house.
宮中也。从广廷聲。
久屋朽木。从广酉聲。《周禮》曰：“牛夜鳴則𢉷。”臭如朽木。
蔽也。从广幷聲。
地名。从广，未詳。
中伏舍。从广卑聲。一曰屋庳。或讀若逋。
奄# cover/conceal + 广 building → small dwelling covered with a thatched roof → *hermitage*; (Buddhist) *monastery*.

The relevant seal inscription form depicts the head of an animal burning over a fire + 广 building → indoor fire burning a pile of *many* and *various* kinds of objects, including animal parts → *multitude*. Compare 諸.
屋下眾也。从广、炗。炗，古文光字。
庚# (firm husk) + four marks suggesting scattered rice → firm, taut husk of a grain plant → *healthy*; *sound* (← firm and taut). 康 was devised to replace 庚 after 庚 acquired its borrowed meanings.

用# use + an abbreviated form of 庚 (firm stem) → *use* a stem or similar *ordinary* tool in performing routine *work* (such as constructing an earthen wall; compare 墉) → *common* (← ordinary) → *mediocre*. "Employee" and "reward" are borrowed meanings (compare 傭).
用也。从用从庚。庚，更事也。《易》曰：“先庚三日。”
As per 臾# (bulging) + 广 building → *granary/storehouse* bulging with grain or crops.
水槽倉也。从广臾聲。一曰倉無屋者。
As per 則# (beside) + 广 building → *toilet* beside a residence → *mingle* (← toilet used in common).
清也。从广則聲。

相# mutual + 广 building → (rooms in a) *wing*, aligned with those opposite → *side room*. In Japan, the character also refers to an (overhang attached to) *eaves*. It also indicates a *passageway*, generally under the eaves (or extension of the eaves) of the main roof, that partially or completely encloses the main part of a building.
廊也。从广相聲。
夏# summer + 广 building → summer residence → *house*.
屋也。从广夏聲。
As per 兼# (gather then put/store away) + 广 building → gather a series of objects and store them away indoors. *Purity*, *honesty* and *cheap* are borrowed meanings.
庂也。从广兼聲。
As per 郎# (flow) + 广 building → flowing (= extensive) passageway of a building → *hallway*; *corridor*; *gallery*.
東西序也。从广郎聲。《漢書》通用郎。
As per 叟# (search) + 广 building → *search* for/*seek* something concealed within a narrow space → *conceal*; *be concealed*.
A composite of elements taken from 馬# horse and 鹿 deer → odd, *imaginary beast with a single horn* (not necessarily the unicorn of Western legend).

𣪘# is 皀 (feed animals) + 殳 action indicator → feed animals. 𣪘 was devised to replace 皀 after the latter's transformation of meanings. 廏 adds 广 building → *barn/stable* (in which farm animals are sheltered and fed).
馬舍也。从广㲃聲。《周禮》曰：“馬有二百十四匹爲廏，廏有僕夫。”
少劣之居。从广堇聲。
郭# enclosure; quarters + 广 building → expansive (enclosed) building → *wide*; *spread." *Enclosure*, *quarters* and *red-light district* are borrowed meanings via 郭.
屋麗廔也。从广婁聲。一曰穜也。
陰# shadow + 广 building → covering structure that provides both *shade* and *protection* → *cover*.
人姓。从广，未詳。當是省廫字尔。
行屋也。从广異聲。
As per 尌# as described in 樹 (set/stand in place) + 广 building → storage closet (for foodstuffs) → *kitchen*. Note a variant form 厨.
庖屋也。从广尌聲。
广 building + an element# combining 田 field and 坴 stretch → long strip of buildings/shops in close proximity → *shop*(s); (expansive) *residence*.
一畝半，一家之居。从广、里、八、土。
斯# split + 广 building → *servant* assigned menial chores such as splitting wood in a shed.
As per 欽# restrain + 广 building → within an enclosed structure, ready the equipment required by a deterring military force → *obstruct* (← deter); *align* (← align equipment).
陳輿服於庭也。从广欽聲。讀若歆。
朝# dynasty + 广 building → imperial court. Later, 廟 was applied to a *temple* or *shrine* (← place for venerating ancestors ← place for paying respects to the emperor) → *mausoleum*.
尊先祖皃也。从广朝聲。
敞# high and wide + 广 building → spacious *workshop*.
As per 無# (concealed) + 广 building → concealed hallway/passageway within a building or compound → (concealed) *passageway under eaves* → *eaves*. *Luxuriant vegetation* is a borrowed meaning via 蕪.
堂下周屋。从广無聲。

As per 發# (split away in being released) + 广 building → building materials released as a structure splits apart (compare 壞 and 崩) → *abandon*; *abolish*; *decline*; *go out of use/fashion*; *die out*.
屋頓也。从广發聲。

As per 黃# (extend) + 广 building → long building that extends far over its locale → *stretch*; *extensive*; *spacious*; *vast*; *spread*; *widespread*; *enlarge* → *be popular* (← widespread popularity).
殿之大屋也。从广黃聲。
芻藁之藏。从广會聲。
牆也。从广辟聲。
As per 解# (protective element) + 广 building → protected *government office*. Compare 衙.
稟# granary + 广 building → *granary*. 廩 was devised to replace 稟 after the latter acquired extended meanings in addition to "granary."
空虚也。从广膠聲。
As per 盧# (sunken) + 广 building (for emphasis/clarification) → structure partially sunk into the earth → *hut*; *cottage*.
寄也。秋冬去，春夏居。从广盧聲。
安止也。从广嬰聲。鉅鹿有廮陶縣。
雝# as described in 擁 (contain) + 广 building → *house enclosed* or contained by a wall, moat etc. → *wrap gently* → *gentle*.
天子饗飲辟廱。从广雝聲。
As per 聽# hear/listen + 广 building → official building in which appeals are heard → *government office/department* → *hall*.
The left-hand element of 延 extend → *extension*.
長行也。从彳引之。凡廴之屬皆从廴。
A variant form of 廷 (garden with extensive vegetation) emphasizing the "extend" rather than the "garden" aspect → *extend*; *spread* → *prolong*; *postpone*; *total of*.
長行也。从㢟丿聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form of the right-hand element is a variant of 千 (advance through luxuriant vegetation). The left-hand element# was originally a long line indicating extension → *garden* with luxuriant, extensive vegetation → (imperial/law) *court*; (governmental) *office*.
朝中也。从廴壬聲。
聿 implement held upright to carve/draw characters (→ upright object) + an abbreviated form# of 延 extend → extend vertically in making erect (compare 寒) → *build/erect* → *establish*.
立朝律也。从聿从廴。
回# rotation + 廴 extension → *circulate/revolve* at length → *go about*; *turn (around)*; *return*.
A depiction of a *pair of hands* → *hold up/out* → *offer*; *present* (← hold up/out an object in raising it high in offering).
十# ten (doubled) → *twenty*. Compare 卅 thirty.
二十并也。古文省。
